note: Canonical browser-discovery contract (QA-09 T2, 2026-08-10). Both stacks' tests read this file; drift from either implementation fails. Decisions: (1) union known-table of 13 ids; (2) unknown binaries receive NO fabricated private flag — mode is 'normal' when private is requested (privacy never claimed, flags never guessed); (3) desktop parse is [Desktop Entry]-section scoped (localized Name[xx]= and Desktop Action sections are ignored); Type must equal 'Application' exactly; NoDisplay=true only rejected inside [Desktop Entry]; (4) flatpak host lookup uses the basename of the first Exec token.
